prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet & Verify Your New Companion", "Listen to voice samples and confirm adoption details to ensure your pet fits your workspace setup.", "Test Voice Sample"]
1: ["Welcome to Your New Workspace!", "Your pet is active and ready on your desktop screen.", "Desktop Control & Tray Guide", "Your pet resides in your system tray. Right-click the icon anytime to summon, hide, or open companion options.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
2: ["Select Companion Personality Traits", "Choose personality tendencies and test sound cues to customize how your pet reacts to your work habits.", "Select Personality", "Calm pets stay quiet during focus hours; energetic pets trigger quick animations.", "Play Personality Audio"]
3: ["Transform Your Workspace", "See how an interactive desktop pet seamlessly integrates with your apps and productivity routines."]
4: ["Signing in anchors your companion to this account so your custom pet is never lost when logging in across devices."]
5: ["Building Desktop Animations", "Generating companion graphics and asset packs tailored to your desktop resolution.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
6: ["Turn on completion alert chime so you can safely minimize the window while your pet renders.", "Test Completion Chime"]
7: ["Upload Photos for 3D Customization", "Provide clear photos for optimal mesh generation and accurate companion styling.", "Well-lit photo with clear background contrast", "Select Photos"]
8: ["Your Pet Has Arrived!", "You have unlocked exclusive starter accessories and founder status for your desktop companion.", "Founder Companion Badge Unlocked"]
9: ["Choose Your Companion's Mode", "Select 'Focus Partner' for gentle work reminders or 'Idle Companion' for fun background desk animations. Easily switch anytime."]

verdicts.problem: Asks the user to upload personal photos.
Mentions exclusive free extras and founder status.
